messages:
Aisha: Quick postmortem follow-up — the KV-residency OOM happened again on prod-blue. We need clear owners for profiling artifacts, short-term throttles, and a rollbackable canary. Who takes what?
Jon: I can own artifact collection and the initial analysis. Will grab heap profiles, allocation stacks, and the shard residency timeline. ETA: 36h.
Riley: I'll drive eviction/GC experiments and prepare config diffs. Plan: small soft-residency decrease + increased frag-GC cadence. 72h to a canary plan.
Max: I'll put together a focused load harness to reproduce the pattern and add a CI smoke job. Can also add an assertion on residency delta.
Aisha: Thanks. Quick ask: keep remediation changes reversible and add an ops-safe flag. Also note we should run a small quality eval after changes.
Jon: Artifact commands I used during incident: ```bash
./runtime collect --mode=heap --out=/tmp/pprof_heap.pb
./runtime collect --mode=alloc --out=/tmp/pprof_alloc.pb
python tools/shard_heatmap.py --shards=alpha-* --out=/tmp/shard_heat.json
```
Upload to s3://incidents/pm-3912345678/ and please tag with commit id.
Riley: GC knobs to test: 1) frag_gc_interval=15s -> 7s, 2) soft_residency_pct -= 10, 3) eviction_batch_size + staggered_windows=true. I'll author a small RFC PR with diffs and a one-click rollback.
Max: Repro harness (minimal): ```bash
# small repro loop
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
  curl -s "https://prod-blue.internal/v1/gen?steps=384" &
done
wait
```
This generates the residency spike we saw in traces.
Aisha: Owners recap: Jon = artifacts + short report; Riley = GC + config PR + canary plan; Max = harness + CI smoke. Ops/infra to approve routing flag. I'll schedule a weekly sync.
ops-bot: ACL request: write access to s3://incidents/pm-3912345678 granted to jon, aisha. Remaining: riley, max.
Riley: Blocker: I need access to the canary routing API to implement soft overflow to low-residency pool. @infra please grant.
Aisha: @infra pinged — adding to the emergency queue.
Max: CI smoke job sketch: checks that after 60s of load, KV-residency delta <= 1.15x baseline and no OOMs in the pod. Pseudotest: ```python
start_load(concurrency=12, steps=384)
wait(60)
assert(residency() < baseline*1.15)
```
Jon: I'll surface the first artifact bundle by EOD: s3://incidents/pm-3912345678/artifacts_v1.tar.gz (pprof + heatmaps + short notes).
Riley: Once infra grants routing API, I'll push canary changes to staging with flags: canary-softcap-v0.5 -> staging. Canary window: 2 hours with on-call monitoring.
Aisha: Timeline summary: Jon (36h) artifacts+report; Riley (72h) PR + canary; Max (48h) CI smoke + e2e harness; infra/ops to grant routing API and write S3 perms ASAP. Weekly check-in Wed 09:30.
eva-lab: Reminder: schedule a follow-up eval run after canary to check for semantic regressions on the prompt corpus. Tagging eval team.
Max: Draft MR for smoke job: https://git.internal/runtime/merge_requests/1327 :eyes:
Jon: Uploaded artifacts and short writeup: s3://incidents/pm-3912345678/artifacts_v1.tar.gz :link:
Riley: Pushed initial config PR: https://git.internal/runtime/merge_requests/1331 — includes rollback flag and perf regression guard.
Aisha: Great. If anyone hits blockers post-PR, post here and I will escalate. Keep changes minimal and reversible. Closing initial assignment; will keep thread for updates. :thumbsup:
notes: Short Slack thread capturing postmortem action assignments for KV-residency OOM: owners, commands for artifact collection, repro harness, GC knobs to test, canary plan, CI smoke tests, ACLs and routing API requests, artifact S3 paths, merge request links, and timelines.
